delete.summary: Delete the account and everything stored for it
delete.description: Also removes its friendships and friend requests, its blocks, chats with their messages (the other person loses the chat), shared divans, challenges with all their results, and its results on other people's challenges. Waiting games it made go; its active games end with the other player as winner (and the other keeps the finished game). Revokes the Apple token when there is one. If Apple cannot be reached the account is kept (502) so the call can be repeated.

502.description: Apple could not be reached; nothing was deleted.

200.description: The user with the new avatar.

400.description: invalid_request: a part is missing, empty, longer than 32 characters or not lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

put.description: Free the first time; later changes only 30 days after the last one.

400.description: The name breaks the rules (username_too_short, username_too_long, username_bad_chars, username_reserved).

get.summary: Points, streak and best scores

put.description: Merged with what is stored, keeping the larger value of each field (and, per game, of each best score).

get.summary: The divan: kept and removed couplets

200.description: Every item stored for the user.

put.summary: Merge the phone's divan into the stored one
put.description: Up to 2000 items per request and 20000 per user. Items with no timestamp are ignored. Per key the later keptAt and the later removedAt win, so a couplet is kept when keptAt is after removedAt. Repeating a request changes nothing. A timestamp more than 5 minutes ahead of the server's clock is refused (bad_timestamp). Answers the full merged state.

200.description: Every item stored for the user.

400.description: invalid_request, or bad_timestamp for a time too far ahead.

413.description: payload_too_large (body over 1 MB), or divan_full (the user would have more than 20 000 items).

get.summary: What my friends did: the home «دوستات» feed
get.description: Newest first, 30 a page, from friends only. A friend's likes and reposts are shown only when their `keptVisibility` is `friends` (the switch that also hides their divan). Their solved daily puzzles are shown only when their `dailyVisibility` is `friends`. Taking back a like, or ending the friendship, removes the item.

post.summary: Ask someone to be friends
post.description: Idempotent: asking again changes nothing. If they already asked me, this accepts and we are friends; if we are friends, nothing happens. The built-in demo friend «یه بیت» (username `yebeyt`) accepts at once: I get a live `friend.accepted` from it, and the answer is `friends`. The receiver gets a live `friend.request` (and the sender of a request I accept, `friend.accepted`). If either of us blocked the other, the person is not found (404). A user may send 30 new requests an hour (429 rate_limited); repeats and acceptances do not count.

200.description: Where we stand now: `requested`, or `friends` when it was accepted or we already were.

404.description: No user with that username.

429.description: rate_limited: 120 calls a minute, or 30 new requests an hour, per user.

delete.description: Idempotent, silent. Does nothing to a request they sent me or to a friendship.

404.description: No user with that username.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

post.summary: Accept the request they sent me
post.description: We are friends now, and they get a live `friend.accepted`. Idempotent: 200 when we are already friends. 404 when they sent no request (or one of us blocked the other).

404.description: No user with that username.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

post.summary: Reject the request they sent me
post.description: Silent: the request just goes away, the sender is not told and may send a new one at once. Idempotent.

404.description: No user with that username.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

delete.description: Idempotent and silent: they are not told, and either of us may send a new request.

404.description: No user with that username.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

get.summary: My friends, 50 a page
get.description: Ordered by when we became friends, newest first.

get.summary: Friend requests I received or sent, newest first, 50 a page
get.description: `direction=incoming` are the people who asked me (answer with accept or reject); `outgoing` are the people I asked (cancel with DELETE).

put.description: Idempotent. Removes the friendship and the friend requests between the two. A blocked pair cannot send friend requests, message or share a divan with each other (and cannot invite each other to games), and each is hidden from the other's profile lookup (404) and search. The blocked person is not told.

404.description: No user with that username.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

delete.description: Idempotent. The friendship and requests removed by the block do not come back.

404.description: No user with that username.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

get.summary: People I blocked, newest first, 50 a page

post.summary: Report a person or one of their messages
post.description: For abuse or spam. A report is read by the team; the reported person is not told. 10 reports a minute per user.

400.description: invalid_request: a bad body, or that is yourself.

404.description: No such user, or no such message of theirs in a chat I am in.

429.description: Too many reports (10 a minute per user).

get.summary: Reports, newest first, 50 a page

post.summary: Open the chat with someone (made if it does not exist)
post.description: Allowed when the other person takes messages from everyone («بهم پیام بده: همه»), or from friends and we are friends, or already wrote to me in this chat; otherwise 403 messages_closed. If either of us blocked the other, the person is not found (404). The chat shows in the list once it has a message.

403.description: username_required, or messages_closed: they do not take messages from me.

404.description: No user with that username, or one of us blocked the other.

get.summary: My chats with the latest message and the unread count, newest first, 50 a page
get.description: Only chats with at least one message, and not with someone blocked either way.

get.summary: How many unread messages and friend requests I have, for the tab badge
get.description: The other people's messages after the last one I read, in all chats that nobody blocked. System lines and deleted messages do not count. `friendRequests` is how many friend requests wait for my answer.

get.summary: Messages of a chat, newest first
get.description: Only for the two people of the chat. 50 at most per page (`limit`); `before` is the `nextBefore` of the previous page.

400.description: A malformed id, cursor or limit.

404.description: No such chat, or I am not in it, or one of us blocked the other.

post.summary: Send a text or a couplet
post.description: `kind` is `text` (`text`, 1–1000 characters) or `couplet` (`key` and an optional `note` of up to 200). Idempotent per sender and `clientId`: a repeat answers 200 with the first message. Blocks and «بهم پیام بده» are checked on every send (403 messages_closed); answering a person who already wrote in the chat is always allowed, unless blocked. 30 messages a minute per user. Both people get a live `message` event. A message to the demo friend «یه بیت» (`yebeyt`) gets one couplet back after 1–2 seconds, as a normal live `message` (at most one reply per 2 seconds and 30 a day per person; none while blocked).

200.description: This client id was already sent; the first message.

403.description: username_required, or messages_closed: blocked, or they do not take messages from me.

404.description: No such chat, or I am not in it.

409.description: conflict: the client id was used for a message in another chat.

429.description: Too many messages (30 a minute per user).

put.summary: Mark a chat as read up to a message
put.description: Never moves backwards. The other person gets a live `read` event (with my username) when the mark moved, which is their «دیده شد».

404.description: No such chat, or I am not in it, or the message is not in it.

delete.description: Idempotent. The message stays in the chat as «deleted»; its text, couplet and note are removed. System lines cannot be deleted. Both people get a live `deleted` event.

404.description: No such message, or I am not in its chat.

post.summary: Open the divan I share with a friend (made if it does not exist)
post.description: Only between friends (403 forbidden otherwise). If either of us blocked the other, the person is not found (404).

403.description: username_required, or forbidden: we are not friends.

404.description: No user with that username, or one of us blocked the other.

get.summary: My shared divans with their counts, newest first, 50 a page
get.description: Not including divans with someone blocked either way.

get.summary: The couplets of a shared divan, newest first, 50 a page
get.description: `by` keeps the ones added by me (`me`), by them (`them`) or all (default). `counts` always count the whole divan. Stays readable if we stop being friends.

404.description: No such divan, or I am not in it, or one of us blocked the other.

post.summary: Add a couplet
post.description: Only while we are friends. Puts a system line `{ event: "divan_add", key }` in our chat (made if there is none; it ignores «بهم پیام بده» because we are friends), and both of us get live `message` and `divan` events. Adding a couplet that is already there answers 200 with the item that is there, and adds nothing. 60 a minute per user.

403.description: username_required, or forbidden: we are not friends any more.

404.description: No such divan, or I am not in it, or one of us blocked the other.

429.description: Too many requests (60 a minute per user).

delete.description: Only the person who added it. Its likes go with it.

403.description: forbidden: they added it; or username_required.

404.description: No such divan or couplet, or I am not in it.

put.summary: Like a couplet of the shared divan
put.description: Idempotent. Either of the two people may like any couplet in it.

200.description: The couplet with the likes now.

404.description: No such divan or couplet, or I am not in it.

delete.description: Idempotent. Either of the two people may like any couplet in it.

200.description: The couplet with the likes now.

404.description: No such divan or couplet, or I am not in it.

post.summary: Start a game with a friend
post.description: Makes a game that waits for a second player (the first to join takes the seat), with a four-character `code`. Each `invite` becomes a chat message of kind `game` with payload `{gameId, kind, code}` (a chat is made if there is none, whatever their `messagesFrom` says); a person who blocked you or whom you blocked, who has no such username, the demo friend «یه بیت» (`yebeyt`, which takes no games), or who takes game invitations only from friends (`gameInvitesFrom`) when you are not one, is skipped and named in `skipped`. 20 games an hour per user.

201.description: The game, who was invited and who was skipped.

400.description: invalid_request: مشاعره without a valid `turnSeconds`, or رودررو with one other than 8.

429.description: rate_limited: 20 games an hour per user.

post.summary: Join a waiting game
post.description: Whoever comes first takes the second seat; the game is then active (a live `game.started` event goes to both). Joining a game I am already in answers 200 and changes nothing. A رودررو game then starts by itself once both players have a live socket (see the README).

200.description: The game (also when I was already in it).

404.description: No such game or code, or the person who made it and I blocked each other.

409.description: game_full: somebody else took the seat, or the game is over.

post.summary: Join a waiting game by its code
post.description: Same as joining by id, for a game that is not done (a done game's code is free again). The code is read in any case, with O as 0 and I or L as 1. 20 a minute per user.

200.description: The game (also when I was already in it).

404.description: No such game or code, or the person who made it and I blocked each other.

409.description: game_full: somebody else took the seat, or the game is over.

429.description: rate_limited: 20 a minute per user.

get.summary: A game I play in
get.description: Players only (404 for anyone else). A مشاعره game whose turn has run out is ended first, with the other player as winner.

200.description: The game with its couplets or rounds.

404.description: No such game, or I am not a player.

get.summary: My games: waiting and active ones, and the ones that ended in the last 7 days
get.description: Newest first, at most 50, without the couplets or rounds (read one game for those). Overdue مشاعره games are ended first.

post.summary: Play a couplet in مشاعره
post.description: My turn only. The creator opens with any couplet; each next one must start with the last letter of the previous couplet's second hemistich (letters compared without diacritics: آ as ا, ي as ی, ك as ک, ۀ and ة as ه, ئ as ی; punctuation and half-spaces skipped), and no couplet repeats in a game. `key` is the couplet the phone matched; the server fetches that poem from Ganjoor (at the commit the app's data comes from) and checks that `m1` and `m2` are its text, ignoring diacritics, punctuation and Arabic letter forms (400 `bad_couplet`; 503 `unavailable` when Ganjoor cannot be reached). A request after the turn's deadline (the last move, or the start, plus `turnSeconds`) ends the game with the other player as winner and answers 409 `turn_over`. 20 moves a minute per user. A good move is +1 for me, passes the turn, and sends live `game.move` and `game.turn` events to both players.

400.description: invalid_request, or bad_couplet: the key is not a couplet or its text is not Ganjoor's, or the couplet has no letter to continue from.

404.description: No such game, or I am not a player.

409.description: not_your_turn, wrong_letter, already_played, turn_over (the game just ended) or game_not_active (waiting or done).

429.description: rate_limited: 20 moves a minute per user.

503.description: unavailable: Ganjoor could not be reached; or busy: too many poems were fetched from Ganjoor in the last minute (60 for the whole server).

post.summary: «کم آوردم»: give up
post.description: Ends an active game with the other player as winner. Anytime in an active game, not only on my turn.

404.description: No such game, or I am not a player.

post.summary: Challenge friends to the ten couplets I just played
post.description: Makes a challenge that lasts 30 days. Share `url` (yebeyt.com/c/<code>, four characters); anyone can play it, with or without an account. 30 an hour per user.

400.description: invalid_request: not ten different keys of couplets in the game deck, or a score or time out of range.

429.description: rate_limited: 30 an hour per user.

get.summary: A challenge, for the page and the app that open its link
get.description: No account needed (all lookups together share 600 a minute). The code is read in any case, with O as 0 and I or L as 1. An expired or unknown code is 404.

200.description: Who made it, the couplets and their score.

404.description: No such challenge, or it expired.

429.description: rate_limited: 600 lookups a minute for the whole server.

post.summary: Leave my result on a challenge
post.description: Signing in is optional. Without an account `name` is required; with one the result is mine, one per person (a second is 409 `conflict`), and the maker's own challenge cannot be answered by the maker (409 `conflict`). The maker gets a live `challenge.result` event, and when the player has an account too (and nobody blocked the other) a `game` message `{event: "challenge_result", code, game, score, seconds}` in their chat. Signed-in users may send 60 an hour; all guests together 120 an hour.

400.description: invalid_request: a score or time out of range, or no valid `name` without an account.

401.description: A token was sent and it is not valid.

404.description: No such challenge, or it expired.

409.description: conflict: I already left a result, or it is my own challenge.

429.description: rate_limited.

get.summary: My challenges with their results
get.description: Newest first, at most 50, the ones that have not expired. Results of people I blocked or who blocked me are left out.

get.summary: Find people by the start of their username
get.description: Case-insensitive prefix match on the username, at least 2 characters, up to 20 results in alphabetical order, never including me or anyone who blocked me or whom I blocked. 60 searches a minute per user.

400.description: invalid_request: shorter than 2 characters after trimming.

429.description: Too many searches (60 a minute per user).

get.summary: A person's public profile
get.description: Name, avatar, how many friends they have, whether we are friends or a request is open (`friendship`). Their league tier and points this week are given only to a friend, to themselves and when they allow the global leaderboard.

404.description: No user with that username, or one of us blocked the other.

get.summary: Who an invite link is from, for yebeyt.com/i/<username>
get.description: No account needed. Only the username, the display name and the face.

404.description: No such username.

429.description: rate_limited: 1200 lookups a minute for the whole server, both endpoints together.

get.summary: Who a game link is from, for yebeyt.com/g/<code>
get.description: No account needed. Only a game that still waits for its second player; the code is read in any case, with O as 0 and I or L as 1.

200.description: The kind of game and who made it.

404.description: No waiting game with this code.

429.description: rate_limited: 1200 lookups a minute for the whole server, both endpoints together.

put.description: `kind` is `like` or `repost`. Idempotent. The couplet is the `key` query parameter (no body). A reaction is social by nature: friends see it in their feed. Reposting a couplet is only this reaction.

schema.description: The couplet key; the `#` must be percent-encoded (`%23`).

parameters.description: The couplet key; the `#` must be percent-encoded (`%23`).
parameters.name: key

200.description: The couplet's counts after the change.

400.description: invalid_request: a bad kind or key.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

delete.summary: Take back a like or a repost
delete.description: Idempotent. The couplet is the `key` query parameter (no body).

schema.description: The couplet key; the `#` must be percent-encoded (`%23`).

parameters.description: The couplet key; the `#` must be percent-encoded (`%23`).
parameters.name: key

200.description: The couplet's counts after the change.

400.description: invalid_request: a bad kind or key.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

get.summary: Likes and reposts of up to 50 couplets
get.description: Everyone's reactions are counted, not only friends'. Every asked key is in the answer, with zeros when nobody reacted.

schema.description: Up to 50 couplet keys, comma separated (the `#` in a key must be percent-encoded).

parameters.description: Up to 50 couplet keys, comma separated (the `#` in a key must be percent-encoded).
parameters.name: keys

400.description: invalid_request: a bad key, or more than 50.

get.summary: My own likes and reposts
get.description: Newest first, 200 a page. The phone pulls them when it signs in.

post.summary: Report a finished round
post.description: Idempotent on `roundId` (the same user sending it again gets the stored result and nothing is added; another user's round id is 409 `conflict`). `daily` counts once per user per Tehran day (of `playedAt`) and `onboarding` once per user ever: a second round of either, with a new `roundId`, is 409 `conflict`. `points` over the game's cap is 400 `points_too_high` (daily 100, jigsaw 320, poet, second and book 440, match 50, listen 100, onboarding 50). `playedAt` must be within the last 48 hours and at most 5 minutes ahead (400 `bad_timestamp`). The round counts for the Tehran week the server receives it in, and the first score of a week puts the user in a league group.

200.description: The week and the user's points this week.

409.description: conflict: the round id belongs to another user, or a daily / onboarding round already counted.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

post.summary: Report the daily puzzle's result
post.description: One result per Tehran day, kept first-write-wins: sending the day again changes nothing and answers the stored result. `date` may be from 48 hours ago (by Tehran date) up to today (400 `bad_timestamp`). `tries` is 1 to 3, also when not solved. The points go in `/v1/scores`.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

get.summary: How my friends did in a day's puzzle
get.description: Friends who reported that day, solved first, then by fewer tries, up to 100. A friend whose `dailyVisibility` is `me` is left out, and not counted. `solvedCount` is how many of the listed friends solved it.

get.summary: My points, streak and league
get.description: `totalPoints` and `weekPoints` come from the reported rounds. `streakDays` counts the days in a row the daily puzzle was solved (reported results, Tehran dates), ending today or yesterday; it stays until the day after the missed one ends.

get.summary: My league this week
get.description: Groups of up to 30 people of one tier. A stranger in the group who is not on the global list is `hidden`: no username, name or picture (the app shows «یه نفر»), but their points and rank are real; friends and people on the global list show normally. The first score of a week puts me in a group of the tier I earned last week (tier 0 to begin with). At the week's end the top 5 move up a tier and the bottom 5 down (ties go to the earlier last score). Before my first score of the week `rows` is empty and `tier` is the one I will start in.

get.summary: This week's points: me and my friends
get.description: Friends with no score are listed with 0. Best first, then by username; up to 100.

get.summary: This week's points: everyone who allows it
get.description: People with `inGlobalLeaderboard` on (and a username) who scored this week, best first (ties by user id), 50 a page. `me` is my own rank among them, also when I am hidden; null before my first score of the week.

post.summary: Send a report: a bug, something annoying, an idea, a game idea or a thank-you
post.description: Signing in is optional; when signed in the report carries the user (the admin sees the username). Signed-in users may send 10 an hour; all guests together 120 an hour. Nothing about the connection is stored. Answers an upload token for the attachments.

400.description: Breaks the rules for its type.

401.description: A token was sent but it is not valid.

429.description: Too many reports.

put.summary: Attach a screenshot to a report
put.description: For reports of type bug, annoyed, idea; image/jpeg or image/png, at most 3 MB, and the first bytes must match the declared type; one per report, within 15 minutes of sending it. Hourly budget: 200 MB per signed-in user, 500 MB for all guests' reports together; refused uploads cost nothing. At most 3 uploads are handled at once, and the file must arrive within 60 seconds.

400.description: Empty, or the report's type takes no screenshot.

403.description: Wrong, missing or expired upload token.

404.description: No such report.

408.description: upload_timeout: the file took longer than the time allowed to arrive.

409.description: already_uploaded: this report already has a screenshot.

415.description: Wrong media type, or the file does not start like the declared type.

429.description: rate_limited: the hourly upload budget is used up (200 MB per signed-in user; 500 MB for all guests together).

503.description: busy: too many uploads at once; retry after the Retry-After seconds.
